neighbours.label: the comma right after a verb of agreeing or disagreeing ('We agree,' 'The President agreed,')
fire: The committee reviewed the request and agreed, and the funds were released.
When asked whether the rule was fair, the judge disagreed, citing two cases.
Several readers wrote in to point out the error. We agree, and have corrected it.
Her father suggested a short break, and she agreed, though reluctantly.
The union proposed a new schedule; management agreed, provided overtime was capped.
Critics called the plan reckless. The minister disagreed, of course.
My brother wanted to leave early and his wife agreed, so they left at nine.
The reviewers asked for more data. The authors agreed, and ran a second trial.
quiet: The committee reviewed the request and met again, and the funds were released.
When asked whether the rule was fair, the judge paused, citing two cases.
Several readers wrote in to point out the error. We checked, and have corrected it.
Her father suggested a short break, and she stood up, though reluctantly.
The union proposed a new schedule; management replied, provided overtime was capped.
Critics called the plan reckless. The minister responded, of course.
My brother wanted to leave early and his wife packed, so they left at nine.
The reviewers asked for more data. The authors waited, and ran a second trial.
